description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The horizontal axis displays language family categories—IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque—listed in descending order based on task count, while the vertical axis, labeled “# tasks”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each language family is represented by a single, solid-colored bar; the bars range in length from approximately 1 task for Basque, to approximately 75 tasks for IE-Romance. Specifically, the IE-Romance bar is light blue and extends to approximately 75, the IE-Germanic bar is medium blue and extends to approximately 40, the Uralic bar is green and extends to approximately 25, the IE-Baltic bar is orange and extends to approximately 20, the IE-other bar is red and extends to approximately 15, the IE-Indic bar is yellow and extends to approximately 12, the Semitic bar is orange and extends to approximately 10, the Turkic bar is light blue and extends to approximately 8, and the Basque bar is dark blue and extends to approximately 1. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
